description: This file defines an object 'WakeWords' containing constants and utility functions related to processing wake words, including parsing comma-separated strings, detecting changes, and sanitizing lists of words.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparated
methods.description: Splits an input string by commas, trims, and filters out empty strings, returning a list of words.

methods.name: parseIfChanged
methods.description: Parses the input string and compares it with the current list; returns a new list if changed, or null if unchanged.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Cleans the list of words by trimming, filtering, limiting length, and falling back to defaults if the result is empty.
